mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = i.spu_id LEFT JOIN product_category cat ON cat.id = spu.category_id AND cat.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_category cat2 ON cat2.id = cat.parent_id LEFT JOIN product_category cat3 ON cat3.id = cat2.parent_id

sql.if: AND (i.product_name_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR i.sku_code_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR i.spu_code_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

AND (oi.product_name_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR oi.sku_code_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR oi.spu_code_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR o.order_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT i.sku_id AS skuId, i.spu_code_snapshot AS spuCode, i.product_name_snapshot AS productName, i.sku_code_snapshot AS skuCode, i.spec_name_snapshot AS specName, i.sale_unit_snapshot AS saleUnit, MAX(COALESCE(cat3.name, cat2.name, cat.name)) AS rootCategoryName, MAX(cat.name) AS leafCategoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customerCount, SUM(i.actual_quantity) AS confirmedQuantity, ROUND(SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(i.actual_quantity), 0), 4) AS avgTransactionPrice, SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) AS settlementAmount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS amountRank FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND
GROUP BY i.sku_id, i.spu_code_snapshot, i.product_name_snapshot, i.sku_code_snapshot, i.spec_name_snapshot, i.sale_unit_snapshot ORDER BY SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, i.sku_id

SELECT cat.id AS categoryId, MAX(cat.name) AS leafCategoryName, MAX(COALESCE(cat3.name, cat2.name, cat.name)) AS rootCategoryName, SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) AS settlementAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customerCount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS amountRank FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND cat.id IS NOT NULL AND
GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, cat.id

WITH rf AS (SELECT r.customer_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM order_refund r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.completed_at >= #{startAt} AND r.completed_at < #{endAt} GROUP BY r.customer_id) SELECT o.customer_id AS customerId, MAX(cu.customer_code) AS customerCode, MAX(cu.name) AS customerName, MAX(e.actual_name) AS sellerName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) AS skuKindCount, SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) AS settlementAmount, COALESCE(MAX(rf.refund_amount), 0) AS completedRefundAmount, MAX(o.confirmed_at) AS lastConfirmedAt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS amountRank FROM sales_order o JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN customer cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id AND cu.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = o.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE LEFT JOIN rf ON rf.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE
GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, o.customer_id

WITH ord AS (SELECT o.id, o.seller_id, o.customer_id, o.confirmed_at, SUM(i.settlement_line_amount) AS line_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = FALSE
WHERE
GROUP BY o.id, o.seller_id, o.customer_id, o.confirmed_at), rf AS (SELECT o2.seller_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM order_refund r JOIN sales_order o2 ON o2.id = r.order_id AND o2.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.completed_at >= #{startAt} AND r.completed_at < #{endAt} GROUP BY o2.seller_id) SELECT ord.seller_id AS sellerId, COALESCE(MAX(e.actual_name), '未分配销售员') AS sellerName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ord.customer_id) AS customerCount, SUM(ord.line_amount) AS settlementAmount, COALESCE(MAX(rf.refund_amount), 0) AS completedRefundAmount, MAX(ord.confirmed_at) AS lastConfirmedAt FROM ord LEFT JOIN rf ON rf.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ord.seller_id LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = ord.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE GROUP BY ord.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(ord.line_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, ord.seller_id

SELECT o.id AS orderId, i.id AS orderItemId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, o.customer_code_snapshot AS customerCode, o.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, e.actual_name AS sellerName, o.order_source AS orderSource, o.settle_mode_snapshot AS settleMode, i.spu_code_snapshot AS spuCode, i.product_name_snapshot AS productName, i.sku_code_snapshot AS skuCode, i.spec_name_snapshot AS specName, i.product_type_snapshot AS productType, i.sale_unit_snapshot AS saleUnit, i.ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity, i.actual_quantity AS actualQuantity, i.locked_unit_price AS lockedUnitPrice, i.locked_price_source AS lockedPriceSource, i.settlement_line_amount AS settlementLineAmount, i.manual_price_override AS manualPriceOverride, i.manual_price_reason AS manualPriceReason FROM sales_order o JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = o.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE
WHERE
ORDER BY o.confirmed_at DESC, o.id DESC, i.sort_order, i.id

WITH po AS (SELECT oi.sku_id, oi.purchase_unit_snapshot, MAX(oi.spu_code_snapshot) AS spu_code, MAX(oi.product_name_snapshot) AS product_name, MAX(oi.sku_code_snapshot) AS sku_code, MAX(oi.sku_name_snapshot) AS sku_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.purchase_order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.planned_quantity) AS planned_quantity, SUM(oi.received_quantity) AS received_quantity, SUM(oi.line_amount) AS order_amount FROM purchase_order_item oi JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id = oi.purchase_order_id WHERE oi.deleted = FALSE AND
GROUP BY oi.sku_id, oi.purchase_unit_snapshot), ic AS (SELECT q.sku_id, STRING_AGG(q.unit_snapshot || ' ' || CAST(q.qty AS TEXT), ' / ' ORDER BY q.unit_snapshot) AS inbound_quantity_text, SUM(q.cost_amount) AS inbound_cost_amount, SUM(q.cost_missing_count) AS inbound_cost_missing_count FROM (SELECT m.sku_id, m.unit_snapshot, SUM(m.quantity) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity * m.unit_cost), 0) AS cost_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.unit_cost IS NULL) AS cost_missing_count
AND m.sku_id = #{query.skuId} GROUP BY m.sku_id, m.unit_snapshot) q GROUP BY q.sku_id) SELECT po.sku_id AS skuId, po.spu_code AS spuCode, po.product_name AS productName, po.sku_code AS skuCode, po.sku_name AS skuName, po.purchase_unit_snapshot AS purchaseUnit, po.order_count AS orderCount, po.planned_quantity AS plannedQuantity, po.received_quantity AS receivedQuantity, po.order_amount AS orderAmount, ROUND(po.order_amount / NULLIF(po.planned_quantity, 0), 4) AS avgPurchasePrice, ic.inbound_quantity_text AS inboundQuantityText, COALESCE(ic.inbound_cost_amount, 0) AS inboundCostAmount, COALESCE(ic.inbound_cost_missing_count, 0) AS inboundCostMissingCount FROM po LEFT JOIN ic ON ic.sku_id = po.sku_id ORDER BY po.order_amount DESC NULLS LAST, po.sku_id

SELECT o.id AS purchaseOrderId, oi.id AS purchaseOrderItemId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.submitted_at AS submittedAt, o.status AS status, o.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplierName, e.actual_name AS purchaserName, o.warehouse_name_snapshot AS warehouseName, o.planned_arrival_date AS plannedArrivalDate, oi.spu_code_snapshot AS spuCode, oi.product_name_snapshot AS productName, oi.sku_code_snapshot AS skuCode, oi.sku_name_snapshot AS skuName, oi.purchase_unit_snapshot AS purchaseUnit, oi.planned_quantity AS plannedQuantity, oi.received_quantity AS receivedQuantity, oi.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, oi.line_amount AS lineAmount FROM purchase_order o JOIN purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_id = o.id AND oi.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = o.purchaser_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE
ORDER BY o.submitted_at DESC, o.id DESC, oi.sort_order, oi.id

SELECT TO_CHAR((o.submitted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bizDate, oi.sku_id AS skuId, MAX(oi.sku_code_snapshot) AS skuCode, MAX(oi.product_name_snapshot) AS productName, oi.purchase_unit_snapshot AS purchaseUnit, ROUND(SUM(oi.purchase_price * oi.planned_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.planned_quantity), 0), 4) AS weightedAvgPrice, COUNT(*) AS sampleLineCount FROM purchase_order_item oi JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id = oi.purchase_order_id WHERE oi.deleted = FALSE AND
GROUP BY 1, 2, 5 ORDER BY 1, 2, 5
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN purchase_receipt src_receipt ON m.source_document_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT_ITEM' AND src_receipt.id = m.source_document_id LEFT JOIN inventory_outbound src_outbound ON m.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND src_outbound.id = m.source_document_id LEFT JOIN inventory_stocktake src_stocktake ON m.source_document_type = 'STOCKTAKE_ITEM' AND src_stocktake.id = m.source_document_id LEFT JOIN inventory_loss_gain src_loss_gain ON m.source_document_type = 'LOSS_GAIN_ITEM' AND src_loss_gain.id = m.source_document_id LEFT JOIN inventory_transfer src_transfer ON m.source_document_type IN ('TRANSFER_OUT_ITEM', 'TRANSFER_IN_ITEM') AND src_transfer.id = m.source_document_id LEFT JOIN inventory_conversion src_conversion ON m.source_document_type IN ('CONVERT_OUT_ITEM', 'CONVERT_IN_ITEM') AND src_conversion.id = m.source_document_id
COALESCE(src_receipt.receipt_no, src_outbound.outbound_no, src_stocktake.stocktake_no, src_loss_gain.loss_gain_no, src_transfer.transfer_no, src_conversion.conversion_no)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'STOCKTAKE_LOSS') AS stocktakeLossCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'LOSS_REPORT') AS lossReportCount, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity * m.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'STOCKTAKE_LOSS'), 0) AS stocktakeLossCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity * m.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'LOSS_REPORT'), 0) AS lossReportCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity * m.unit_cost), 0) AS totalLossCostAmount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.unit_cost IS NULL) AS costMissingCount FROM inventory_movement m LEFT JOIN product_sku k ON k.id = m.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = k.spu_id WHERE

SELECT m.id AS movementId, m.occurred_at AS occurredAt, m.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, spu.name AS productName, k.sku_code AS skuCode, m.movement_type AS lossType, m.quantity AS quantity, m.unit_snapshot AS unit, m.unit_cost AS unitCost, ROUND(m.quantity * m.unit_cost, 4) AS costAmount, AS sourceDocumentNo, m.operator AS operator FROM inventory_movement m LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = m.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sku k ON k.id = m.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = k.spu_id
WHERE ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC, m.id DESC
